_note: M4 locked palette (spec §3.3). Reference colours by NAME, never a hex literal in a scene or script (§3). The 12 saturated NOTE hues are NOT here — NoteColors generates them, and they are the only saturated colours in the game. Nothing in the environment may use a note hue. Budget: 32 total (7 rock + 12 note + player + resonant + UI).

lighting._note: cave_ambient is the CanvasModulate multiplier (§5.1): how dark the world goes before the additive lights bring it back. Lighter = more of the room readable unlit; darker = more dramatic. Tune this and the per-light energies together.
